response.sql: WITH album_stats AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(Bytes * 1.0 / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS overall_avg FROM album_stats WHERE avg_bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.avg_unit_price, a.avg_bytes_per_ms, a.avg_bytes_per_ms - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall_avg FROM album_stats a CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE a.avg_bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC LIMIT 10
